description: This header file defines utility functions, types, and validation routines for managing device instance names and configurations within the Cuttlefish Android virtualization project. It includes function declarations for retrieving configuration paths, validating device and instance names, and manipulating device name structures, as well as template functions for set operations.

classes.name: DeviceName
classes.description: A struct representing a device's group name and per-instance name.

methods.name: GetCuttlefishConfigPath
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration path for Cuttlefish based on the home directory.

methods.name: LocalDeviceNameRule
methods.description: Generates a local device name based on group and instance names.

methods.name: IsValidInstanceName
methods.description: Checks if a given token is a valid instance name.

methods.name: IsValidGroupName
methods.description: Checks if a given token is a valid group name.

methods.name: IsValidDeviceName
methods.description: Checks if a device name matches the pattern <valid group name>-<valid instance name>.

methods.name: BreakDeviceName
methods.description: Parses a device name into its constituent group and per-instance components.

methods.name: GenerateTooManyInstancesErrorMsg
methods.description: Creates an error message when there are too many instances.

methods.name: Intersection
methods.description: Computes the intersection of sets or containers, supporting multiple arguments.
